# Why this file is needed: training small LMs needs torch, transformers,
# tokenizers, accelerate, datasets and trl at mutually compatible versions,
# plus z3-solver / python-sat for labels. This is a long list of pinned
# transitive dependencies that cannot be installed reliably from a notebook.
#
# Do not edit by hand. Edit requirements.in, then regenerate:
#   pip-compile --no-header --strip-extras --no-emit-index-url \
#       -o requirements.txt requirements.in
